title: pkg/trust: parseUids can panic on malformed GPG uid/pub lines
body:
`parseUids` in `pkg/trust/policy.go` reads the colon-delimited GnuPG key
listing and, for each line starting with `uid:` or `pub:`, does:

```go
uid := strings.Split(line, ":")[9]
```

The index `[9]` assumes every `uid`/`pub` record has at least 10
colon-separated fields. GnuPG's `--with-colons` output does not guarantee
that — records can legitimately have fewer fields — so a short line makes
this panic with `index out of range [9] with length N`.

Since this data comes from `gpg` output parsed at runtime, a malformed or
truncated record can crash podman instead of being skipped.

**Fix:** guard the field count and skip records that are too short before
indexing field 9.

**Environment:** any (parsing bug, platform independent).
